description: Department of Local Government - Eastern Province - Summon the Meeting of Fill the Vacancies Arose as a result of resigning the post of Vice Chairman of the Koralipattu West P.S. at 10.00 a.m. on 29.04.2021
reasoning: This gazette content specifically concerns the summoning of a meeting to fill a vacancy in a local authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, under the Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act. This falls directly under electoral processes at the local government level, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
